title: [Bug]: Window Hopper: Alt + ` hotkey fails to trigger, but works fine in Command Palette

status.label: Design investigation queued
status.detail: The report is reproducible enough for code investigation; no additional reporter information is currently needed.

next_action.label: Investigate Window Hopper Alt-only hotkeys
next_action.reason: Trace modifier detection in the centralized keyboard hook and compare Alt-only activation with working Win-key activation before proposing a fix.

judgment.rationale: The report isolates the failure to Window Hopper's default Alt+VK_OEM_3 global shortcut while the same module works after switching to a Win-key shortcut, providing a focused runner/module hotkey path to investigate.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2432 preview is affected on Windows 11 25H2.
Alt+backtick does not activate Window Hopper, while changing the Window Hopper shortcut to Win+backtick does.
The reporter reproduced the behavior with Microsoft Pinyin, WeChat Input Method, and a standard US keyboard.
Window Hopper publishes Alt+VK_OEM_3 and Shift+Alt+VK_OEM_3 through PowertoyModule::update_hotkeys into the runner's centralized low-level keyboard hook.
The centralized hook reconstructs modifier state with GetAsyncKeyState when processing WM_KEYDOWN or WM_SYSKEYDOWN.
judgment.recommended_action: Perform a focused design investigation of Alt modifier detection and VK_OEM_3 matching in the centralized keyboard hook, then add regression coverage before changing the shared runner path.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper's default Alt+backtick shortcut does not activate globally, but the module activates when configured with Win+backtick; input-method changes do not alter the result.
known_information: The affected build is PowerToys 0.101.2432 preview on Windows 11 25H2.
Window Hopper is enabled and its default next-window shortcut is Alt+backtick.
Win+backtick successfully activates Window Hopper on the same system.
The failure persists across Microsoft Pinyin, WeChat Input Method, and a US keyboard layout.
A diagnostic ZIP is attached, although automated triage rejected an oversized archive entry.
The module defaults to virtual key 0xC0 and routes activation through the runner's centralized keyboard hook.
inferences: The working Win-key configuration suggests Window Hopper initialization and overlay activation are functional.
The failure may be in shared Alt modifier state detection or shortcut matching, but the current evidence does not yet prove the exact failing branch.
Because the runner hook is shared by modules, a fix should avoid special-casing Window Hopper until the shared behavior is reproduced and measured.
issue_context.analysis: The report supplies a stable A/B comparison on one machine and rules out the most obvious input-method explanation. The next useful step is code-level reproduction and instrumentation of the shared low-level hook, not another generic information request.
initial_investigation: Reviewed AltWindowCycle::get_hotkeys and AltWindowCycle::on_hotkey in src/modules/AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp.
Confirmed the default next-window shortcut is Alt+VK_OEM_3 in both native module and Settings UI defaults.
Traced registration through PowertoyModule::update_hotkeys to CentralizedKeyboardHook::SetHotkeyAction.
Confirmed CentralizedKeyboardHook::KeyboardHookProc derives Alt state with GetAsyncKeyState(VK_MENU) while handling WM_KEYDOWN and WM_SYSKEYDOWN.

information_gaps.information: A debugger or test-harness trace of KBDLLHOOKSTRUCT flags, wParam, vkCode, and reconstructed modifier state for failing Alt+backtick and working Win+backtick.
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies whether the mismatch occurs before module dispatch and distinguishes modifier detection from module activation failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce in a local debug build or a focused centralized keyboard-hook test harness without adding permanent logging to the hook hot path.
